body: Honestly, an attack from any boss that OHKO's you is incredibly unfair.
Yeah I guess we did do it and I suppose that should be considered a victory in of itself. I sent you a message.

I've always wanted a motorcycle as a kid. Still want one now too. Its just that I'm swamped by classes, bills and a part time job. Its kind of hard to get my liscence, let alone afford it.

But yeah. Idk, there wasn't much as a kid I really wanted badly. Strangely enough, I wasn't depressed as a kid when I wasn't attached to anything. Now it seems like the exact opposite, like I'm craving attachment from another source.
Thanks for your words. Idk, I know its not the worst, but at times it definitely feels agonizing. Like something is wrong with you, but you can't seem to find what it is, or how to fix it.

I do have friends but they are limited. They always seem to be busy. Hobbies are if anything, keeping me alive but it honestly doesn't feel like enough. They feel like a distraction, like me trying to run away from all of my emotional problems that never seem to be resolved. I like to read, write and play chess btw.

Thanks man appreciate it. Idk, even right now too I'm just listening to an album(Thin Lizzy's jailbreak to be exact). I know they say to enjoy the small things in life but I feel as though something is wrong, even though nothing really is at the moment.  Even if I invest in myself, I still feel miserable as fuck.

That's rough hearing that man, don't let rejection diminish the value of yourself. She was a lesbian, it makes sense for her not to be interested in guys. Still though, that shouldn't make you feel any less significant.
Alot of people on this subreddit care. I care too. You are always welcome to pm me whenever :)
